name: merge-step-returns-to-pending
goal: A project workflow can put command steps in the before-merge slot; the merge gate runs them in order and stops at the first failing command. Today a command step the gate never reached stays `running` after the gate ends. Make such a step return to `pending` when the gate finishes without running it, so a later gate run can pass it.
acceptance: pnpm exec vitest run tests/control/workflow-steps.test.ts tests/control/workflow-engine.test.ts
